description: Derived, not a transcription: the real-analysis facts are proved in Mathlib (strict monotonicity, convergence to 1, geometric HasSum) and the clock is shown to be an order embedding of the existing SupertaskMoment order. First Mathlib-based result; its Comparator config permits exactly propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound (docs/axiom-policy.md). A mathematical model only; SU-REAL (#318) stays open.
